style.styleTitle: Personalised Christmas Nutcracker LED Lantern by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: This stunning personalised Christmas nutcracker LED Lantern is a perfect way of adding a stylish touch to any home. The lantern can be personalised with 2 lines of text up to 25 characters each. Please note that all text entered will appear as entered. The battery-powered lantern has a realistic flickering warm orange flame effect, adding an ambient touch to any room, it can be switched on/off from a switch on the base. It requires x3 AAA batteries which are not included. This product has a matt plastic finish. Height 27 cm, Width 10.3 cm, Depth 10.3 cm.
